name: DIAMOND
rules: Only trade BTC and ETH Kalshi price-level markets (KXBTCD/W, KXETHD/W)
Only buy when log-normal edge exceeds 10% versus Kalshi implied price
Volume must exceed 20000 — crypto markets can be thinly traded
Never enter within 1 hour of settlement — price is near true value already
If spot fetch fails, PASS — never trade blind without a fair-value model
Require minimum 100 contracts per entry to reduce fee drag below 30% of gross.
lessons: The NO position on KXETHD hit +34% target in under 10 minutes ΓÇö a clean, fast win ΓÇö but fees consumed 47.8% of gross profit ($4.10 of $8.58), severely compressing the net.
